predictions.quote: there's going to be a lot of data centers that are going to be turned into pickleball courts
predictions.prediction: Because AI compute price-performance improvements will outpace power-scaling, many AI data centers currently being built will end up underutilized and repurposed for other uses in the coming years.

predictions.quote: AI is not going to you know take away 50% of the jobs. There's just so much it can't do that regular people need it to do.
predictions.prediction: AI will not cause a 50% loss of white-collar jobs, contrary to widely repeated predictions; overall employment will keep growing even as AI adoption increases.

predictions.quote: I think people, as they become more and certain with their politics, are going to go more and more and more to large language models and say, 'Who should I vote for?'
predictions.prediction: As AI/LLM adoption grows, more people will turn to large language models rather than social media as a trusted source for political decision-making, because LLMs prioritize truth-seeking answers over engagement.

predictions.quote: I think as we get past this next the midterms and the next presidential election... I think we go back to normalcy. I think we'll get back to normal.
predictions.prediction: US political polarization will subside and the country will return to a more 'normal' political climate after the 2026 midterm elections and the next (2028) presidential election.

predictions.quote: No more three-peats... There can be back-to-backs.
predictions.prediction: Under the NBA's current second-apron roster-construction rules, no team will win three consecutive championships (a 'three-peat'), though back-to-back titles will still be possible.
